preamble: WHEREAS it is expedient to provide for the retention in service of certain persons enrolled for service in the Bangladesh Navy; It is hereby enacted as follows:—

sections.title: Short title and commencement

body.text: This Act may be called the [* * *] Navy (Extension of Service) Act, 1950.
It shall come into force at once.

notes: The word “Pakistan” was omitted by section 2(b) of প্রতিরক্ষা কর্মবিভাগ (কতিপয় আইন সংশোধন) আইন, ২০১৬ (২০১৬ সনের ১৫ নং আইন)।

sections.title: Extension of service where term of service has expired

body.text: Until such date as may be notified in this behalf by the [Government] any person enrolled for service in the Bangladesh Navy who, by reason of the expiry of the term for which he was engaged to serve when so enrolled, is no longer liable for service shall, notwithstanding such expiry, continue to be enrolled for service and to be liable for service in the Bangladesh Navy until he is discharged by the order of the Officer Commanding the Bangladesh Navy:
Provided that the period for which the service of any such person is extended under this section shall not exceed five years from the day on which his service would otherwise have terminated.

notes: The word “Government” was substituted for the words “Central Government” by section 2(c) of প্রতিরক্ষা কর্মবিভাগ (কতিপয় আইন সংশোধন) আইন, ২০১৬ (২০১৬ সনের ১৫ নং আইন)।

sections.title: Repeal
notes: Section 3 was omitted by section 2(d) of প্রতিরক্ষা কর্মবিভাগ (কতিপয় আইন সংশোধন) আইন, ২০১৬ (২০১৬ সনের ১৫ নং আইন)।
